odia: ରୋହଦ୍ର ଖରାରେ ଯେ ବସଇ ମୁହିଁ, ଆ ଛାଇକି ବୋଲି ବୋଲନ୍ତି ନାହିଁ
title: No one calls me into the shade
literal_meaning: I sit in the fierce sun; they do not say, “Come into the shade.”
explanation: This voice complains of a small kindness withheld. The speaker is exposed to fierce heat, while the wished-for response is only an invitation into shade. The line makes neglect tangible without telling us who the others are or why they remain silent. Read conversationally, it can express the hurt of being overlooked when someone could easily acknowledge a difficulty. That broader use follows the image; it is not a documented original occasion or a claim that every unspoken offer is deliberate cruelty.
meaning_odia: ପ୍ରଚଣ୍ଡ ଖରାରେ ବସିଥିବା ମଣିଷଟି ଅନେକ କିଛି ମାଗୁନାହିଁ; ଛାଇକୁ ଆସ ବୋଲି ପଦେ ଡାକକୁ ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରୁଛି। ସେ ଡାକ ନ ମିଳିବାରେ ଅଭିମାନ ରହିଛି। ଦେଖିପାରୁଥିବା କଷ୍ଟ ପ୍ରତି ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଧ୍ୟାନ ନ ଦେବାକୁ ଏହି ଚିତ୍ର ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କରେ। କିଏ ଡାକିଲେ ନାହିଁ ବା ସେମାନଙ୍କ ସହ କି ସମ୍ପର୍କ, ପଦଟି ନିଜେ ତାହା କହେନାହିଁ।
english_summary: The speaker feels overlooked when even a simple invitation to shelter is missing.
odia_summary: କଷ୍ଟ ଦେଖି ମଧ୍ୟ ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଆଶ୍ରୟକୁ ଡାକ ନ ମିଳିବାର ଅଭିମାନ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: After helping arrange an outdoor meeting, a volunteer remains in the sun while the others sit under the canopy. Later the volunteer quotes the line to a friend, describing the hurt of not being invited to join them.
cultural_context: ରୋହଦ୍ର is explicitly glossed unbearably hot. Speaker, place and relationship are unnamed. Neglect is a reading of the direct complaint; no heat-safety instruction, biography or historical scene is inferred.
